content.title: Kansas vs California Baptist schedule, TV channel for March Madness
content.text: Updated March 17, 2026, 3:33 p.m. MTKansas and California Baptist play in a March Madness NCAA Tournament men's college basketball game on Friday, March 20.Here's what to know about the time, TV channel, streaming information and announcers for the East Region March Madness first-round game.Kansas is the No. 4 seed in the region.Cal Baptist is the No. 13 seed.The winner of this game
